name: g1_relocalise_demo_smoke
_note: Tests A/B with a different start pose in every session; frozen 26 Oct 2026 before any run on these seeds. Fresh nominal rooms 4200-4209 (never used). Sessions are aligned only by dream.memory.relocalise from the robot's own depth (simulator poses score the alignment afterwards). Absence needs two visible-but-undetected looks from different viewpoints (dream.runtime.memory_search). Pre-registered expectations: in unchanged rooms no absence is recorded; recall success >= recall_control success; median recall time below the control where alignment is accepted; refused alignments fall back to a memory-free search and are reported; no false claims; no falls.
